scene.id: Ibu memeluk Adik erat-erat; hati-hati kecil melayang di sekitar mereka.
scene.en: Mom hugs Little Sister tight; little hearts float around them.

scene.id: Kakak memegang bola dan menunjuk ke pintu sambil mengangkat alis mengajak. Adik mengangguk senang.
scene.en: Big Brother holds a ball and points at the door, raising his eyebrows invitingly. Little Sister nods happily.

scene.id: Ayah membuat isyarat tangan angka delapan ala Tiongkok (jempol dan telunjuk membentuk huruf L); di sebelahnya delapan balon dan angka 8.
scene.en: Dad makes the Chinese hand sign for eight (thumb and index finger in an L shape); next to him are eight balloons and the digit 8.

scene.id: Ayah berkemeja menggendong Adik di pundaknya; keduanya tertawa.
scene.en: Dad in his shirt carries Little Sister on his shoulders; both are laughing.

scene.id: Papan berisi sepuluh baris bintang kecil, tiap baris sepuluh bintang, dengan angka 100 di atasnya.
scene.en: A board with ten rows of ten small stars each, with the digit 100 above it.

scene.id: Langit biru siang hari dengan matahari bersinar; Adik bermain layang-layang di taman kompleks.
scene.en: A blue daytime sky with the sun shining; Little Sister flies a kite in the estate's park.

scene.id: Ibu memotong semangka menjadi dua bagian yang sama besar dan mengangkat salah satunya.
scene.en: Mom cuts a watermelon into two equal halves and lifts one of them up.

scene.id: Kukusan bambu terbuka berisi bakpao putih yang mengepul; Nenek mengambil satu.
scene.en: An open bamboo steamer full of steaming white buns; Grandma picks one up.

scene.id: Cangkir bergagang milik Adik dengan motif bintang di atas meja; Adik meraihnya.
scene.en: Little Sister's star-patterned mug with a handle sits on the table; she reaches for it.

scene.id: Tiga buku bertumpuk, dengan angka 3 di atasnya.
scene.en: Three books in a stack, with the digit 3 above them.

scene.id: Adik berdiri di tepi jalan dan menunjuk ke satu sisi jalan, tempat sebuah pohon dan bangku berada; panah menandai sisi itu.
scene.en: Little Sister stands at the edge of a road and points to one side of it, where a tree and a bench are; an arrow marks that side.

scene.id: Adik terbaring lemas di tempat tidur dengan termometer di mulut, wajahnya merah, kain kompres di dahi.
scene.en: Little Sister lies limp in bed with a thermometer in her mouth, a flushed face and a cool cloth on her forehead.

scene.id: Adik menggeleng keras dengan tangan bersilang, menolak sesendok sayur yang disodorkan Ibu (balon berisi tanda silang).
scene.en: Little Sister shakes her head hard with crossed arms, refusing the spoonful of vegetables Mom offers (bubble with a cross).

scene.id: Panel 1: Kakak mengambilkan bola Adik yang jatuh, Adik berterima kasih (balon berisi hati). Panel 2: Kakak tersenyum dan mengibaskan tangan dengan santai.
scene.en: Panel 1: Big Brother picks up Little Sister's dropped ball and she thanks him (bubble with a heart). Panel 2: he smiles and waves it off casually.

scene.id: Ibu menyodorkan sepiring sayur; Adik menggeleng dan mengangkat telapak tangan menolak (balon kata berisi tanda silang).
scene.en: Mom holds out a plate of vegetables; Little Sister shakes her head and raises a palm to refuse (speech bubble with a cross).

scene.id: Ibu menaruh sepiring sayur hijau tumis yang masih mengepul di atas meja.
scene.en: Mom sets a plate of steaming stir-fried greens on the table.

scene.id: Teko tanah liat dan cangkir kecil berisi teh hijau mengepul, dengan beberapa daun teh di sampingnya.
scene.en: A clay teapot and a small cup of steaming green tea, with a few tea leaves beside them.

scene.id: Adik bernyanyi di depan cermin dengan sisir sebagai mikrofon; not-not musik melayang.
scene.en: Little Sister sings in front of the mirror using a hairbrush as a microphone; music notes float around.

scene.id: Supermarket besar: Ibu mendorong troli di lorong rak yang penuh buah, susu, dan mi.
scene.en: A big supermarket: Mom pushes a shopping cart down an aisle of shelves full of fruit, milk and noodles.

scene.id: Jalan dengan beberapa kendaraan: sepeda, mobil, dan bus.
scene.en: A road with several vehicles: a bicycle, a car and a bus.

scene.id: Adik makan semangkuk mi dengan sumpit; pipinya menggembung.
scene.en: Little Sister eats a bowl of noodles with chopsticks, her cheeks puffed out.

scene.id: Adik memakai jaket; satu lengan sudah masuk dan ia berusaha memasukkan lengan yang lain.
scene.en: Little Sister puts on a jacket; one arm is in and she is wriggling to get the other one in.

scene.id: Taksi kuning dengan lampu di atap berhenti di tepi jalan kota; sopir membukakan pintu belakang untuk Ayah.
scene.en: A yellow taxi with a roof light stops at the kerb of a city street; the driver opens the back door for Dad.

scene.id: Semangka besar di samping jeruk kecil; Kakak memeluk semangka yang besar itu.
scene.en: A big watermelon next to a small orange; Big Brother hugs the big watermelon.

scene.id: Nenek menempelkan ponsel di telinga dan bicara sambil tersenyum; di panel sebelah, Ayah di kantor menjawab teleponnya.
scene.en: Grandma holds her phone to her ear and talks with a smile; in the next panel Dad answers the call at his office.

scene.id: Ibu melambai ke seluruh keluarga yang sudah duduk di meja makan dan memanggil mereka semua (balon kata berisi gambar semua orang).
scene.en: Mom waves to the whole family already seated at the dining table and calls them all (speech bubble with a picture of everyone).

scene.id: Pesawat sudah mendarat; Nenek keluar dari pintu kedatangan menarik koper, dan Adik berlari menyambutnya.
scene.en: The plane has landed; Grandma comes out of the arrivals gate pulling a suitcase, and Little Sister runs to meet her.

scene.id: Kampus universitas yang luas dengan gedung-gedung besar; Kakak dan teman kuliahnya bersepeda melewati halaman.
scene.en: A large university campus with big buildings; Big Brother and his classmate cycle across the grounds.

scene.id: Teman kuliah Kakak, seorang mahasiswa, berjalan di kampus dengan ransel di punggung dan laptop di tangan.
scene.en: Big Brother's classmate, a university student, walks across campus with a backpack and a laptop.

scene.id: Adik memeluk boneka beruangnya dan Kakak memegang bolanya. Panah melengkung menghubungkan tiap anak dengan barang miliknya.
scene.en: Little Sister hugs her teddy bear and Big Brother holds his ball. Curved arrows link each child to their own thing.

scene.id: Lomba lari santai di taman: Kakak di podium angka 1, teman kuliahnya di podium angka 2, dan Ayah yang ngos-ngosan di podium angka 3.
scene.en: A fun run in the park: Big Brother on podium 1, his classmate on podium 2 and an out-of-breath Dad on podium 3.

scene.id: Toko kecil di pinggir jalan: apel dan jeruk ditata di depan pintu, dan penjual melambai dari dalam.
scene.en: A small shop at the side of a street: apples and oranges are laid out in front of the door and the seller waves from inside.

scene.id: Jam weker menunjuk tepat pukul 7 dan berdering; Adik terbangun di tempat tidur.
scene.en: An alarm clock rings at exactly 7 o'clock; Little Sister wakes up in bed.

scene.id: Telepon meja merah dengan tombol angka dan gagang yang berdering; gelombang bunyi di sekitarnya.
scene.en: A red desk phone with number buttons and a ringing handset; sound waves around it.

scene.id: Komputer meja dengan monitor, keyboard, dan mouse; Kakak sedang mengetik.
scene.en: A desktop computer with a monitor, keyboard and mouse; Big Brother is typing.

scene.id: Kakek menonton acara memasak di TV dari sofa, remote di tangan.
scene.en: Grandpa watches a cooking show on TV from the sofa, remote in hand.

scene.id: Gulungan film dan papan klapper polos di samping seember popcorn.
scene.en: A film reel and a blank clapperboard next to a bucket of popcorn.

scene.id: Bioskop yang gelap dengan layar besar bercahaya; Kakak dan teman kuliahnya makan popcorn.
scene.en: A dark cinema with a big glowing screen; Big Brother and his classmate eat popcorn.

scene.id: Ayah menunjuk foto lama: di foto itu Ayah remaja menggendong adik laki-lakinya yang masih balita.
scene.en: Dad points at an old photo: in it, teenage Dad is carrying his toddler little brother.

scene.id: Ibu menuang isi tas belanjanya ke meja: sabun, buah, mainan, dan baterai.
scene.en: Mom tips out her shopping bag on the table: soap, fruit, a toy and batteries.

scene.id: Nenek membawa sepiring pangsit ke meja, dan semua yang lain (Kakek, Ayah, Ibu, Kakak, Adik) mengangkat tangan bersamaan dengan antusias.
scene.en: Grandma brings a plate of dumplings to the table, and everyone else (Grandpa, Dad, Mom, Big Brother, Little Sister) raises their hands at once, eager.

scene.id: Adik membaca keras-keras dari buku dengan mulut terbuka lebar (balon kata kosong).
scene.en: Little Sister reads aloud from a book with her mouth wide open (empty speech bubble).

scene.id: Kakak menulis 2 + 2 = 4 di papan tulis; guru tersenyum dan memberi tanda centang besar. Di sebelahnya ada jawaban salah yang disilang.
scene.en: Big Brother writes 2 + 2 = 4 on the blackboard; the teacher smiles and adds a big tick. Next to it a wrong answer is crossed out.

scene.id: Kakak tidak sengaja menumpahkan teh di meja Ayah. Ia membungkuk dalam-dalam dengan wajah menyesal, kedua tangan di depan dada.
scene.en: Big Brother accidentally spills tea on Dad's table. He bows deeply with a sorry face, both hands in front of his chest.

scene.id: Dua mangkuk berdampingan: satu penuh menggunung pangsit, satu hanya berisi dua. Kakak menunjuk mangkuk yang penuh dengan gembira.
scene.en: Two bowls side by side: one piled high with dumplings, the other holding just two. Big Brother happily points at the full one.

scene.id: Di pasar, Ayah menunjuk tumpukan jeruk dan bertanya ke penjual (balon berisi tanda tanya dan koin).
scene.en: At the market, Dad points at a pile of oranges and asks the seller (bubble with a question mark and a coin).

scene.id: Kakek membaca buku di kursi malasnya sambil membetulkan kacamata.
scene.en: Grandpa reads a book in his armchair, adjusting his glasses.

scene.id: Dua bakpao putih di atas piring, dengan angka 2 di atasnya.
scene.en: Two white steamed buns on a plate, with the digit 2 above them.

scene.id: Ayah merangkul bahu Kakak dengan bangga saat Kakak memegang piala; wajah mereka mirip.
scene.en: Dad proudly puts his arm around Big Brother, who holds a trophy; their faces look alike.

scene.id: Nampan makan berisi semangkuk nasi, sepiring sayur, sepiring daging, dan sepasang sumpit.
scene.en: A meal tray with a bowl of rice, a plate of vegetables, a plate of meat and a pair of chopsticks.

scene.id: Restoran dengan meja bundar berputar; pelayan membawa nampan berisi pangsit.
scene.en: A restaurant with lazy-Susan round tables; the waiter carries a tray of dumplings.

scene.id: Kamar Adik: tempat tidur kecil, meja belajar, dan rak berisi boneka; Adik duduk di lantai bermain.
scene.en: Little Sister's room: a small bed, a desk and a shelf of stuffed toys; she sits on the floor playing.

scene.id: Kakak makan hot pot yang sangat pedas: wajahnya merah padam, asap keluar dari telinganya, cabai di sekelilingnya.
scene.en: Big Brother eats a very spicy hot pot: his face is bright red, steam comes out of his ears and chillies surround him.

scene.id: Pesawat terbang di langit biru meninggalkan jejak putih; Adik menunjuk ke atas.
scene.en: A plane flies across the blue sky leaving a white trail; Little Sister points up at it.

scene.id: Jarum panjang jam bergeser lima garis kecil; Ibu menunggu tehnya selesai diseduh.
scene.en: The clock's long hand moves on by five small marks; Mom waits for her tea to finish steeping.

scene.id: Pengatur waktu dapur menunjuk angka 10 dan jarum menitnya berputar; Kakak menunggu telurnya matang. Angka 10 di atasnya.
scene.en: A kitchen timer is set to 10 and its dial turns; Big Brother waits for his eggs to cook. The digit 10 above it.

scene.id: Adik melompat gembira dengan senyum lebar sambil memegang balon; di sebelahnya Adik cemberut karena balonnya terbang lepas.
scene.en: Little Sister jumps for joy with a big smile, holding a balloon; next to it she sulks because her balloon has floated away.

scene.id: Ayah, Ibu, dan Adik berdiri berjajar; di depan mereka ada tiga apel. Orang dan apel sama-sama diberi angka 1, 2, 3.
scene.en: Dad, Mom and Little Sister stand in a row; in front of them are three apples. The people and the apples are both numbered 1, 2, 3.

scene.id: Not-not musik warna-warni mengalir dari speaker kecil; Nenek bergoyang mengikuti lagu.
scene.en: Colourful music notes stream from a small speaker; Grandma sways along to the song.

scene.id: Kakak berhoodie menepuk kepala Adik yang jauh lebih pendek; Adik mendongak menatapnya.
scene.en: Big Brother in his hoodie pats the head of much shorter Little Sister; she looks up at him.

scene.id: Kakek memberikan angpau merah kepada Adik dengan dua tangan.
scene.en: Grandpa gives Little Sister a red envelope with both hands.

scene.id: Gedung kantor tinggi berkaca; Ayah berjas membawa tas kerja masuk lewat pintu putar bersama para pekerja lain.
scene.en: A tall glass office building; Dad in a suit carries his briefcase through a revolving door along with other workers.

scene.id: Ayah bekerja di depan laptop di meja kantornya; di sebelahnya ada tumpukan berkas dan secangkir kopi.
scene.en: Dad works at his laptop at his office desk, with a pile of papers and a mug of coffee beside him.

scene.id: Anjing kecil berbulu kuning berlari mengibaskan ekor di taman; Adik melempar bola untuknya.
scene.en: A small yellow dog runs wagging its tail in the park; Little Sister throws a ball for it.

scene.id: Dua tas di etalase: satu berlabel harga 999, satu berlabel 9. Ibu terbelalak melihat yang mahal.
scene.en: Two bags in a shop window: one with a price tag of 999, one with 9. Mom's eyes pop at the expensive one.

scene.id: Bola dunia dengan garis batas negara; satu negara diwarnai terang.
scene.en: A globe with country borders; one country is coloured brightly.

scene.id: Jam menunjuk pukul 11 malam dan bulan terlihat di jendela, tapi Kakak masih belajar di mejanya.
scene.en: The clock shows 11 at night and the moon is in the window, but Big Brother is still studying at his desk.

scene.id: Ibu menggandeng tangan Adik di taman; Adik melompat-lompat kecil di sampingnya.
scene.en: Mom holds Little Sister's hand in the park; Little Sister skips along beside her.

scene.id: Guru menunjuk peta Tiongkok; Kakak dan teman kuliahnya mengucapkan sesuatu bersama (balon kosong).
scene.en: The teacher points at a map of China; Big Brother and his classmate say something together (empty speech bubble).

scene.id: Kakek menyiapkan kuas, tinta, dan kertas berpetak tianzige (kotak dengan garis silang) yang masih kosong.
scene.en: Grandpa sets out a brush, ink and blank tianzige grid paper (squares with cross guidelines).

scene.id: Kalender dinding dengan satu tanggal (angka 15) dilingkari merah; Adik menunjuknya dengan senang.
scene.en: A wall calendar with one date (the digit 15) circled in red; Little Sister points at it happily.

scene.id: Ibu mengacungkan jempol sambil memegang apel merah yang segar dan mengilap. Di meja sebelahnya ada apel cokelat yang busuk.
scene.en: Mom gives a thumbs-up while holding a fresh, shiny red apple. Next to her on the table lies a rotten brown apple.

scene.id: Adik mencicip pangsit, matanya berbinar dan jempolnya terangkat. Di sebelahnya, Adik mencicip sayur pahit dengan wajah meringis.
scene.en: Little Sister tastes a dumpling, eyes shining, thumb up. Next to it, she tastes a bitter vegetable and grimaces.

scene.id: Ibu mencoba gaun merah yang cantik dan Nenek mengacungkan jempol; di sebelahnya Ibu dengan gaun kusut kebesaran, Nenek mengernyit.
scene.en: Mom tries on a pretty red dress and Grandma gives a thumbs-up; next to it Mom is in a baggy, crumpled dress and Grandma winces.

scene.id: Nenek tersenyum menikmati Adik bermain piano dengan merdu; di sebelahnya Kakak meniup terompet sumbang dan Nenek menutup telinga.
scene.en: Grandma smiles, enjoying Little Sister's sweet piano playing; next to it Big Brother blasts a squeaky trumpet and Grandma covers her ears.

scene.id: Adik tertawa lepas di atas komidi putar; di sebelahnya, Adik duduk bosan di bangku.
scene.en: Little Sister laughs her head off on a merry-go-round; next to it she sits bored on a bench.

scene.id: Di nampan sarapan ada satu bakpao dan satu gelas susu kedelai, dengan tanda plus di antaranya.
scene.en: A breakfast tray holds one steamed bun and one glass of soy milk, with a plus sign between them.

scene.id: Kakak menyedot bubble tea lewat sedotan besar; butir mutiaranya terlihat naik di sedotan.
scene.en: Big Brother sips bubble tea through a big straw; the tapioca pearls can be seen rising up the straw.

scene.id: Adik mendongak dengan mulut ternganga ke arah gedung apartemen yang sangat tinggi sampai menembus awan.
scene.en: Little Sister looks up, mouth wide open, at an apartment tower so tall it pokes through the clouds.

scene.id: Di antrean halte bus, Ayah berdiri di depan dan Adik di belakangnya; panah menunjuk Adik di belakang.
scene.en: In the bus-stop queue, Dad stands in front and Little Sister behind him; an arrow points at Little Sister at the back.

scene.id: Di tengah jalan, Ayah berbalik karena lupa payung; panah berbentuk U menunjukkan ia kembali.
scene.en: Halfway down the street Dad turns back because he forgot his umbrella; a U-shaped arrow shows him going back.

scene.id: Adik dengan bangga mengayuh sepeda tanpa roda bantu; Ibu bertepuk tangan.
scene.en: Little Sister proudly rides her bike without training wheels; Mom claps.

scene.id: Kereta cepat putih yang ramping melaju di atas jembatan melintasi sawah.
scene.en: A sleek white high-speed train speeds across a bridge over rice fields.

scene.id: Ibu menggenggam beberapa permen di tangan yang tertutup dan bertanya (balon tanda tanya). Adik menebak sambil mengacungkan tiga jari.
scene.en: Mom holds a few sweets in a closed fist and asks (question-mark bubble). Little Sister guesses, holding up three fingers.

scene.id: Gedung apartemen di sore hari; dari satu balkon yang jendelanya menyala, keenam anggota keluarga Xiǎo melambai.
scene.en: An apartment block in the evening; from one balcony with glowing windows, all six members of the Xiǎo family wave.

scene.id: Di gerbang sekolah, Kakak bertemu guru dan menyapanya sambil sedikit membungkuk.
scene.en: At the school gate, Big Brother meets the teacher and greets her with a small bow.

scene.id: Ibu menggantung tiga potong pakaian (jaket, kaus, kemeja) di rak baju toko; angka 3 di atasnya.
scene.en: Mom hangs three pieces of clothing (a jacket, a T-shirt, a shirt) on a shop clothes rack; the digit 3 above them.

scene.id: Ibu berdiri di pintu dengan tangan di dekat mulut, memanggil Kakak yang sedang main bola di luar (balon kata besar).
scene.en: Mom stands at the door with a hand by her mouth, calling Big Brother, who is playing ball outside (big speech bubble).

scene.id: Nenek dan Adik membungkus pangsit di meja dapur; sepiring pangsit mengepul di sebelahnya.
scene.en: Grandma and Little Sister wrap dumplings at the kitchen table; a plate of steaming dumplings sits next to them.

scene.id: Foto keluarga dalam bingkai: keenam anggota keluarga Xiǎo berjajar dan tersenyum.
scene.en: A framed family photo: all six members of the Xiǎo family lined up and smiling.

scene.id: Tiga butir telur ayam di keranjang kecil; satu sedang digoreng Ibu di wajan.
scene.en: Three hen's eggs in a small basket; Mom is frying another one in a wok.

scene.id: Ibu menunjuk foto lama sambil tersenyum: di foto itu Ibu masih kecil, berdiri di samping kakak perempuannya yang lebih tinggi.
scene.en: Mom smiles and points at an old photo: in it she is a little girl standing next to her taller older sister.

scene.id: Kalender tahunan di dinding dengan dua belas kotak bulan kecil, semuanya disorot; Ayah menunjuk kalender itu.
scene.en: A year calendar on the wall with twelve small month grids, all highlighted; Dad points at it.

scene.id: Kalender dinding dengan satu kotak tanggal yang bersinar terang; Adik menunjuk kotak itu, matahari pagi masuk dari jendela.
scene.en: A wall calendar with one date box glowing bright; Little Sister points at it as morning sun comes through the window.

scene.id: Kakak membuat isyarat tangan angka sembilan ala Tiongkok (telunjuk ditekuk seperti kait); di sebelahnya sembilan bola kecil dan angka 9.
scene.en: Big Brother makes the Chinese hand sign for nine (index finger bent like a hook); next to him are nine small balls and the digit 9.

scene.id: Kakek mencicipi sup sambil mengusap dagu; balon pikirannya berisi wajah yang sedang menimbang-nimbang.
scene.en: Grandpa tastes the soup and rubs his chin; his thought bubble shows a face weighing things up.

scene.id: Kakak membuka jendela lebar-lebar dan angin segar berembus masuk.
scene.en: Big Brother throws the window wide open and fresh air blows in.

scene.id: Ayah menyetir mobil dengan dua tangan di kemudi dan mata ke depan.
scene.en: Dad drives the car with both hands on the wheel and eyes on the road.

scene.id: Adik menatap ikan-ikan di akuarium dengan mata melebar.
scene.en: Little Sister looks at the fish in an aquarium with wide eyes.

scene.id: Ibu membawa Adik ke dokter; dokter memeriksa dada Adik dengan stetoskop.
scene.en: Mom takes Little Sister to the doctor; the doctor listens to her chest with a stethoscope.

scene.id: Hujan reda; Adik melihat pelangi di langit lewat jendela dan menunjuk dengan takjub.
scene.en: The rain stops; Little Sister catches sight of a rainbow through the window and points in wonder.

scene.id: Jadwal pelajaran di dinding dengan ikon angka, bola, dan not musik; guru sedang mengajar di depan kelas.
scene.en: A class timetable on the wall with icons for numbers, a ball and music notes; the teacher is teaching at the front.

scene.id: Adik menunjuk bola di rak dan bertanya; Ibu tersenyum dan mengangguk (balon kata berisi tanda centang).
scene.en: Little Sister points at a ball on a shelf and asks; Mom smiles and nods (speech bubble with a check mark).

scene.id: Adik membuka mulut lebar-lebar, "aaa"; dokter menyorotkan senter kecil ke dalam mulutnya.
scene.en: Little Sister opens her mouth wide, "aaah"; the doctor shines a small torch inside.

scene.id: Di kios buah, Adik menyerahkan tiga keping koin kepada penjual untuk sepotong semangka; label harga berangka 3.
scene.en: At a fruit stall, Little Sister hands the seller three coins for a slice of watermelon; the price tag shows 3.

scene.id: Ibu melambai memanggil "ke sini"; Adik berlari mendekat ke arahnya. Panah mengarah ke Ibu.
scene.en: Mom beckons "come here"; Little Sister runs toward her. An arrow points toward Mom.

scene.id: Guru berkacamata berdiri di depan papan tulis sambil memegang buku.
scene.en: The teacher, wearing glasses, stands in front of the blackboard holding a book.

scene.id: Panel 1: mangkuk penuh nasi. Panel 2: mangkuk kosong, Adik menepuk perutnya yang kenyang; ada tanda centang.
scene.en: Panel 1: a full bowl of rice. Panel 2: the bowl is empty and Little Sister pats her full tummy; a tick appears.

scene.id: Adik menggigil berbalut syal di tengah salju, napasnya beruap; di sebelahnya Kakak kepanasan di bawah matahari terik.
scene.en: Little Sister shivers in a scarf in the snow, her breath steaming; next to her Big Brother swelters under the blazing sun.

scene.id: Seekor kucing duduk di dalam kotak kardus, hanya kepalanya yang menyembul; panah menunjuk ke dalam kotak.
scene.en: A cat sits inside a cardboard box with only its head poking out; an arrow points into the box.

scene.id: Ibu memegang dua gelas bubble tea, satu di tiap tangan, dengan angka 2 di atasnya.
scene.en: Mom holds two cups of bubble tea, one in each hand, with the digit 2 above them.

scene.id: Piring kosong yang hanya berisi remah-remah; Adik menunjuknya dengan kecewa, dan angka 0 melayang di atas piring.
scene.en: An empty plate with only crumbs on it; Little Sister points at it, disappointed, and the digit 0 floats above.

scene.id: Kakek membuat isyarat tangan angka enam ala Tiongkok (jempol dan kelingking terbuka); di sebelahnya enam butir telur dan angka 6.
scene.en: Grandpa makes the Chinese hand sign for six (thumb and little finger out); next to him are six eggs and the digit 6.

scene.id: Adik menyodorkan bakpao ke Kakak dengan alis terangkat (balon tanda tanya). Di atas kepala Kakak muncul ikon centang dan silang.
scene.en: Little Sister holds out a steamed bun to Big Brother with raised eyebrows (question-mark bubble). A tick and a cross icon appear above his head.

scene.id: Penjual di kios buah berseru memanggil pembeli sambil menunjuk tumpukan apel berlabel harga; Ibu menyerahkan uang.
scene.en: A seller at a fruit stall calls out to shoppers and points at a pile of apples with a price tag; Mom hands over money.

scene.id: Ibu membeli apel di pasar dan membayar dengan memindai kode QR lewat ponsel; penjual menyerahkan kantong belanjaan.
scene.en: Mom buys apples at the market and pays by scanning a QR code with her phone; the seller hands over the bag.

scene.id: Ibu bercelemek berlutut dan memeluk Adik erat-erat.
scene.en: Mom in her apron kneels down and gives Little Sister a big hug.

scene.id: Ibu memasak sambil menelepon dan mengaduk wajan sekaligus, berkeringat; di sebelahnya Ayah bersantai di sofa.
scene.en: Mom cooks while talking on the phone and stirring the wok all at once, sweating; next to her Dad relaxes on the sofa.

scene.id: Kucing belang tidur melingkar di sofa; Adik mengelus kepalanya.
scene.en: A tabby cat sleeps curled up on a sofa; Little Sister strokes its head.

scene.id: Panel 1: Adik menabrak Nenek sampai jeruk dari tas belanjanya berjatuhan; Adik cemas. Panel 2: Nenek tersenyum dan mengibaskan tangan.
scene.en: Panel 1: Little Sister bumps into Grandma and oranges tumble out of her shopping bag; Little Sister looks worried. Panel 2: Grandma smiles and waves her hand.

scene.id: Kakak menggandeng Adik yang lebih kecil menyeberang jalan di zebra cross.
scene.en: Big Brother holds smaller Little Sister's hand as they cross at a zebra crossing.

scene.id: Kakak jatuh dari sepeda dan Ibu berlari cemas; Kakak bangkit sambil tersenyum dan mengacungkan jempol.
scene.en: Big Brother falls off his bike and Mom runs over, worried; he gets up smiling and gives a thumbs-up.

scene.id: Kakak membalik dompetnya dan tidak ada yang jatuh, hanya debu. Di sebelahnya Adik memegang sekeping koin.
scene.en: Big Brother turns his wallet upside down and nothing falls out but dust. Next to him Little Sister holds up a coin.

scene.id: Panel 1: Adik berdiri sendirian. Panel 2: Adik berdiri bersama temannya dan Kakak; ada tanda plus di antara panel.
scene.en: Panel 1: Little Sister stands alone. Panel 2: she stands with her friend and Big Brother; a plus sign sits between the panels.

scene.id: Roti tawar dan sebuah roti bulat di atas talenan; Kakak menggigit sepotong roti.
scene.en: A loaf of sliced bread and a round bun on a board; Big Brother bites into a slice.

scene.id: Semangkuk mi berkuah panjang; Kakek mengangkat mi tinggi-tinggi dengan sumpit.
scene.en: A bowl of long noodles in soup; Grandpa lifts the noodles high with his chopsticks.

scene.id: Nenek menyendok nasi putih yang mengepul dari rice cooker ke dalam mangkuk.
scene.en: Grandma scoops steaming white rice from the rice cooker into a bowl.

scene.id: Dua kalender tahunan berdampingan dengan panah ke kalender kedua; di balon pikirannya, Adik sudah lebih tinggi.
scene.en: Two year calendars side by side with an arrow to the second one; in her thought bubble Little Sister is already taller.

scene.id: Kalender: panah melompat dari kotak hari ini ke kotak berikutnya yang bergambar keranjang piknik; Adik melompat girang.
scene.en: A calendar: an arrow jumps from today's box to the next box, which has a picnic basket drawn in it; Little Sister jumps for joy.

scene.id: Hari pertama sekolah: Adik menunjuk tanda nama kosong di bajunya sambil memperkenalkan diri ke guru (balon kosong).
scene.en: First day of school: Little Sister points to the blank name tag on her shirt while introducing herself to the teacher (empty bubble).

scene.id: Adik menunjuk apel yang jauh di meja seberang ruangan; apel di tangannya tidak ia hiraukan.
scene.en: Little Sister points at an apple far away on a table across the room, ignoring the one in her hand.

scene.id: Di depan penjual balon, Adik ragu-ragu; jarinya melayang di antara tiga balon berwarna beda (balon pikiran tanda tanya).
scene.en: At a balloon stand, Little Sister hesitates, her finger hovering between three balloons of different colours (thought bubble with a question mark).

scene.id: Pelayan menunjuk meja kosong yang jauh di sisi seberang restoran, dekat jendela.
scene.en: The waiter points to an empty table on the far side of the restaurant, by the window.

scene.id: Kakak menunjuk sepeda merah yang berdiri jauh di seberang jalan; sepeda lain di dekatnya tidak ia hiraukan.
scene.en: Big Brother points at a red bicycle standing far away across the street, ignoring the one beside him.

scene.id: Adik berdiri di depan tiga boneka beruang yang berbeda di rak toko; jarinya melayang di antaranya (balon pikiran tanda tanya).
scene.en: Little Sister stands in front of three different teddy bears on a shop shelf, her finger hovering between them (thought bubble with a question mark).

scene.id: Kakek menunjuk jauh ke sebuah pagoda di atas bukit; Adik mengikuti arah jarinya.
scene.en: Grandpa points far off to a pagoda on a hill; Little Sister follows his finger.

scene.id: Di bandara, Ibu menarik koper dan menoleh ke kiri-kanan mencari gerbang (balon pikiran berisi pesawat dan tanda tanya).
scene.en: At the airport, Mom pulls her suitcase and looks left and right for her gate (thought bubble with a plane and a question mark).

scene.id: Dua ikon di pintu toilet: siluet laki-laki dan siluet perempuan. Ayah menunjuk siluet laki-laki.
scene.en: Two icons on restroom doors: a male figure and a female figure. Dad points at the male figure.

scene.id: Foto lama: Ayah dan Ibu waktu masih pacaran, bergandengan tangan di taman; panah dan hati kecil menunjuk Ayah muda.
scene.en: An old photo: Dad and Mom back when they were dating, holding hands in the park; an arrow and a small heart point at young Dad.

scene.id: Kakak menunjuk kios bubble tea di seberang jalan sambil bicara ke teman kuliahnya.
scene.en: Big Brother points at the bubble tea stand across the street while talking to his classmate.

scene.id: Di stasiun metro, Adik menatap peta jalur yang penuh garis warna-warni dengan bingung; tanda tanya dan pin lokasi di atas kepalanya.
scene.en: In a metro station, Little Sister stares at a colourful route map, confused; a question mark and a location pin float above her head.

scene.id: Adik menunjuk sekumpulan boneka di rak yang jauh di seberang toko.
scene.en: Little Sister points at a group of stuffed toys on a shelf far across the shop.

scene.id: Penjual menyodorkan keranjang berisi bermacam buah. Ibu menimbang-nimbang dan menunjuk beberapa buah (tanda tanya di atasnya).
scene.en: The seller holds out a basket of mixed fruit. Mom considers and points at several pieces (a question mark above her).

scene.id: Panel 1: Ibu menunjuk dirinya dan cangkir teh (balon berisi cangkir). Panel 2: Ibu menunjuk Ayah dengan alis terangkat (balon tanda tanya).
scene.en: Panel 1: Mom points at herself and a teacup (bubble with a cup). Panel 2: she points at Dad with raised eyebrows (question-mark bubble).

scene.id: Ayah mengangkat Kakak dan Adik sekaligus, satu di tiap lengan, sambil tersenyum lebar.
scene.en: Dad lifts Big Brother and Little Sister at the same time, one on each arm, with a big smile.

scene.id: Adik menunjuk lurus ke arah Kakak sambil bicara (balon kosong). Kakak menoleh dan menunjuk dadanya sendiri dengan wajah bertanya.
scene.en: Little Sister points straight at Big Brother while talking (empty speech bubble). He turns and points at his own chest, puzzled.

scene.id: Ibu melambai kepada tetangga yang berdiri di depan pintu apartemen; keduanya tersenyum (balon kata berisi tangan melambai).
scene.en: Mom waves to a neighbour standing at an apartment door; both smile (speech bubble with a waving hand).

scene.id: Satu pohon yang sama dalam empat musim berjajar: berbunga, berdaun hijau, berdaun jingga, dan bersalju; panah melingkar menghubungkannya.
scene.en: The same tree in four seasons side by side: blossoming, green, orange-leaved and snowy; a circular arrow joins them.

scene.id: Guru bicara sambil menyapukan tangannya ke arah Kakak dan teman kuliahnya yang berdiri berdua di depannya.
scene.en: The teacher talks while sweeping her hand toward Big Brother and his classmate standing together in front of her.

scene.id: Dua panel: Adik melambai santai ke Kakak; lalu Adik berdiri rapi dan sedikit membungkuk saat menyapa Kakek dengan sopan (balon berisi hati kecil).
scene.en: Two panels: Little Sister waves casually at Big Brother; then she stands up straight and bows slightly as she greets Grandpa politely (bubble with a small heart).

scene.id: Nenek menuang susu dari kotak susu bergambar sapi ke dalam gelas.
scene.en: Grandma pours milk from a carton with a cow picture into a glass.

scene.id: Dua ikon di pintu toilet: siluet laki-laki dan siluet perempuan. Ibu menunjuk siluet perempuan.
scene.en: Two icons on restroom doors: a male figure and a female figure. Mom points at the female figure.

scene.id: Ibu menyisir dan mengepang rambut Adik yang duduk di depannya.
scene.en: Mom combs and braids the hair of Little Sister, who sits in front of her.

scene.id: Foto lama: Ayah dan Ibu waktu masih pacaran, bergandengan tangan di taman; panah dan hati kecil menunjuk Ibu muda.
scene.en: An old photo: Dad and Mom back when they were dating, holding hands in the park; an arrow and a small heart point at young Mom.

scene.id: Pelayan membungkuk sopan menyambut Ibu yang berpakaian rapi dan membawa tas tangan di lobi hotel.
scene.en: A waiter bows politely to greet Mom, who is smartly dressed and carries a handbag, in a hotel lobby.

scene.id: Adik dan temannya tertawa bersama sambil minum bubble tea.
scene.en: Little Sister and her friend laugh together over bubble tea.

scene.id: Dua apel di kios: satu berlabel harga 3, satu lagi 30; Ibu tersenyum dan mengambil yang murah.
scene.en: Two apples at a stall: one with a price tag of 3, the other 30; Mom smiles and picks the cheap one.

scene.id: Adik memakai gaun bermotif bunga dan berputar di depan cermin; bunga-bunga di vas di sampingnya.
scene.en: Little Sister wears a flower-patterned dress and twirls in front of a mirror; flowers in a vase beside her.

scene.id: Keranjang berisi apel merah mengilap; Adik menggigit satu apel.
scene.en: A basket of shiny red apples; Little Sister takes a bite of one apple.

scene.id: Nenek membuat isyarat tangan angka tujuh ala Tiongkok (ujung jari dikuncupkan); di sebelahnya tujuh pangsit di piring dan angka 7.
scene.en: Grandma makes the Chinese hand sign for seven (fingertips pinched together); next to her are seven dumplings on a plate and the digit 7.

scene.id: Di antrean halte bus, Ayah berdiri di depan dan Adik di belakangnya; panah menunjuk Ayah di depan.
scene.en: In the bus-stop queue, Dad stands in front and Little Sister behind him; an arrow points at Dad in front.

scene.id: Tumpukan koin dan uang kertas berwarna-warni bermotif bunga; Adik menghitungnya di dekat celengan.
scene.en: Piles of coins and colourful banknotes with flower patterns; Little Sister counts them next to her piggy bank.

scene.id: Sepuluh papan berjajar, tiap papan berisi sepuluh baris sepuluh bintang kecil; angka 1000 di atasnya.
scene.en: Ten boards in a row, each with ten rows of ten small stars; the digit 1000 above them.

scene.id: Jam weker berdering; Adik menggeliat lalu duduk di tempat tidur dengan rambut berantakan.
scene.en: The alarm clock rings; Little Sister stretches and sits up in bed with messy hair.

scene.id: Ibu menyodorkan sepiring jeruk kepada teman Adik yang sedang main ke rumah, dengan telapak tangan terbuka mempersilakan ia mengambil.
scene.en: Mom holds out a plate of oranges to Little Sister's friend, who is visiting, with an open palm inviting her to take one.

scene.id: Di pasar, Ayah menyapa penjual dengan sopan sambil mengangkat satu tangan (balon berisi tanda tanya).
scene.en: At the market, Dad politely greets the seller with one hand raised (bubble with a question mark).

scene.id: Kakak berjalan menjauh dari rumah menuju sekolah di kejauhan; panah mengarah menjauh.
scene.en: Big Brother walks away from the house toward the school in the distance; an arrow points away.

scene.id: Kakak melihat fotonya dari tahun lalu ketika ia masih lebih pendek; di belakangnya, panah mundur ke kalender tahunan sebelumnya.
scene.en: Big Brother looks at a photo of himself from last year, when he was shorter; behind him an arrow points back to the previous year calendar.

scene.id: Kakak kepanasan di bawah matahari terik, berkeringat dan mengipas-ngipas wajahnya; di sebelahnya Adik menggigil di tengah salju.
scene.en: Big Brother swelters under the blazing sun, sweating and fanning his face; next to him Little Sister shivers in the snow.

scene.id: Ayah melangkah lebar di trotoar; dilihat dari samping, kedua kakinya membentuk huruf V terbalik, mirip bentuk aksaranya.
scene.en: Dad strides along the pavement; seen from the side, his legs form an upside-down V, just like the shape of the character.

scene.id: Di pasar, Nenek melihat guru; wajahnya langsung cerah karena mengenalinya, dan ia melambai.
scene.en: At the market, Grandma spots the teacher; her face lights up as she recognises her, and she waves.

scene.id: Matahari bulat terbit di atas atap-atap gedung, sinarnya memancar ke segala arah.
scene.en: A round sun rises over the rooftops, its rays shining in every direction.

scene.id: Tiga jeruk berjajar, dengan angka 3 di atasnya.
scene.en: Three oranges in a row, with the digit 3 above them.

scene.id: Seekor kucing duduk di atas kotak kardus; panah ke atas menunjuk kucing itu.
scene.en: A cat sits on top of a cardboard box; an up arrow points at the cat.

scene.id: Pagi hari, Ayah berkemeja dan menenteng tas kerja masuk ke kereta metro yang penuh.
scene.en: In the morning, Dad in his shirt carries his briefcase onto a packed metro train.

scene.id: Toko kecil di sudut jalan: rak penuh makanan ringan; penjual berdiri di balik meja kasir dengan kode QR pembayaran.
scene.en: A small corner shop: shelves full of snacks; the seller stands behind the counter with a QR payment code.

scene.id: Bel berbunyi; guru masuk kelas dan murid-murid duduk siap di bangku.
scene.en: The bell rings; the teacher enters the classroom and the students sit ready at their desks.

scene.id: Jam di kelas menunjuk pukul 10 dan matahari sudah agak tinggi; Adik sedang belajar di kelas.
scene.en: The classroom clock shows 10 o'clock and the sun is fairly high; Little Sister is in class.

scene.id: Pagi hari, Adik berangkat ke sekolah dengan tas di punggung; Nenek melambai dari pintu.
scene.en: In the morning, Little Sister sets off for school with her bag on her back; Grandma waves from the door.

scene.id: Dua mangkuk berdampingan: satu penuh menggunung pangsit, satu hanya berisi dua. Adik cemberut menunjuk mangkuk yang isinya sedikit.
scene.en: Two bowls side by side: one piled high with dumplings, the other holding just two. Little Sister pouts and points at the nearly empty one.

scene.id: Bel pintu berbunyi. Adik berdiri di balik pintu yang tertutup, melihat bayangan seseorang di kaca kecil pintu; tanda tanya di atasnya.
scene.en: The doorbell rings. Little Sister stands behind the closed door, looking at someone's shadow in its small window; a question mark above her.

scene.id: Kakak bersin-bersin dan menggigil berbalut selimut, memegang tisu.
scene.en: Big Brother sneezes and shivers wrapped in a blanket, holding a tissue.

scene.id: Adik memegang kotak hadiah yang tertutup dan mengguncangnya di dekat telinga; tanda tanya besar di atasnya.
scene.en: Little Sister holds a closed gift box and shakes it next to her ear; a big question mark floats above.

scene.id: Ibu menyilangkan dua telunjuk membentuk isyarat angka sepuluh ala Tiongkok; di sebelahnya sepuluh apel dalam dua baris dan angka 10.
scene.en: Mom crosses her two index fingers in the Chinese hand sign for ten; next to her are ten apples in two rows and the digit 10.

scene.id: Ayah menatap daftar tugas di pintu kulkas yang berisi ikon-ikon (belanja, mencuci, membayar tagihan) sambil menggaruk kepala.
scene.en: Dad stares at a to-do list on the fridge door full of icons (shopping, laundry, paying bills) and scratches his head.

scene.id: Ayah memegang foto bayi lalu menunjuk Adik; di antara foto dan Adik ada tanda sama dengan. Adik mengangguk sambil tersenyum.
scene.en: Dad holds up a baby photo and points at Little Sister; an equals sign sits between the photo and her. She nods with a smile.

scene.id: Begitu lampu pejalan kaki berubah hijau, Kakak mulai menyeberang di zebra cross.
scene.en: The moment the pedestrian light turns green, Big Brother starts walking across the zebra crossing.

scene.id: Ayah melirik jam tangannya dengan buru-buru; di belakangnya ada jam dinding dan jam pasir.
scene.en: Dad glances at his wristwatch in a hurry; behind him are a wall clock and an hourglass.

scene.id: Kakak memegang ponsel layar sentuh; di layarnya ada ikon-ikon aplikasi berwarna tanpa merek.
scene.en: Big Brother holds a touchscreen phone; its screen shows colourful unbranded app icons.

scene.id: Sebuah buku tebal bersampul biru yang terbuka, halamannya bergambar; Adik membacanya di sofa.
scene.en: A thick blue book lies open with pictures on its pages; Little Sister reads it on the sofa.

scene.id: Toko buku dengan rak penuh buku bersampul warna-warni tanpa tulisan; Kakak membaca di sudut.
scene.en: A bookshop with shelves full of colourful books with blank covers; Big Brother reads in a corner.

scene.id: Kakek tertidur di kursi malas dengan buku terbuka di pangkuannya; ikon bulan kecil melayang di atas kepalanya.
scene.en: Grandpa has nodded off in his armchair with an open book on his lap; a little moon icon floats above his head.

scene.id: Adik menuang air bening dari botol ke dalam gelas.
scene.en: Little Sister pours clear water from a bottle into a glass.

scene.id: Nenek menyodorkan sepiring buah kepada Adik: apel, pisang, semangka, dan jeruk.
scene.en: Grandma offers Little Sister a plate of fruit: apples, bananas, watermelon and oranges.

scene.id: Adik tidur di tempat tidurnya sambil memeluk boneka beruang; lampu tidur menyala dan bulan terlihat di jendela.
scene.en: Little Sister sleeps in her bed hugging her teddy bear; the night light is on and the moon shows in the window.

scene.id: Guru berbicara di depan kelas dengan satu tangan terangkat; balon kata besar kosong keluar dari mulutnya.
scene.en: The teacher speaks at the front of the class with one hand raised; a big empty speech bubble comes from her mouth.

scene.id: Ibu dan Nenek mengobrol di dapur sambil memotong sayur; balon-balon kata kosong bergantian.
scene.en: Mom and Grandma chat in the kitchen while chopping vegetables; empty speech bubbles take turns.

scene.id: Empat cangkir teh di atas meja, dengan angka 4 di atasnya.
scene.en: Four teacups on a table, with the digit 4 above them.

scene.id: Adik di depan kue ulang tahun dengan lilin berbentuk angka 6, mengacungkan jari sambil tersenyum lebar.
scene.en: Little Sister in front of a birthday cake with a candle shaped like the digit 6, holding up her fingers with a big smile.

scene.id: Adik berbisik ke Ibu sambil menunjuk Ayah yang berdiri agak jauh.
scene.en: Little Sister whispers to Mom while pointing at Dad standing a little way off.

scene.id: Adik menunjuk kucing di sofa sambil bercerita kepada Ibu (balon kata berisi gambar kucing, panah menuju kucing).
scene.en: Little Sister points at a cat on the sofa while telling Mom about it (speech bubble with a picture of the cat, an arrow pointing to the cat).

scene.id: Kakak bicara ke Ayah sambil menunjuk Nenek di seberang ruangan.
scene.en: Big Brother talks to Dad while pointing at Grandma across the room.

scene.id: Adik memakai jaket Ayah yang terlalu besar; lengannya menjuntai sampai lutut.
scene.en: Little Sister wears Dad's jacket, which is far too big; the sleeves hang down to her knees.

scene.id: Ibu bicara ke Nenek sambil menunjuk Ayah dan Kakak yang sedang main bola di halaman.
scene.en: Mom talks to Grandma while pointing at Dad and Big Brother playing ball in the yard.

scene.id: Adik menunjuk dua kucing dan seekor anjing yang bermain di taman sambil bercerita kepada Kakak (balon kata berisi gambar hewan-hewan itu).
scene.en: Little Sister points at two cats and a dog playing in the park while telling Big Brother (speech bubble with pictures of the animals).

scene.id: Ayah bicara ke Kakak sambil menunjuk Ibu, Nenek, dan Adik yang sedang membuat pangsit bersama di meja.
scene.en: Dad talks to Big Brother while pointing at Mom, Grandma and Little Sister making dumplings together at the table.

scene.id: Busur dari kiri ke kanan: matahari terbit, tinggi di siang hari, lalu terbenam dan bulan muncul. Di bawahnya Adik bangun, bermain, lalu tidur.
scene.en: An arc from left to right: the sun rises, stands high at noon, then sets and the moon appears. Below it, Little Sister wakes up, plays, then sleeps.

scene.id: Kakek menonton ramalan cuaca di TV; di layar berjajar ikon matahari, awan, dan hujan.
scene.en: Grandpa watches the weather forecast on TV; sun, cloud and rain icons are lined up on the screen.

scene.id: Adik mendengarkan musik dengan headphone, matanya terpejam; not-not musik melayang.
scene.en: Little Sister listens to music on headphones with her eyes closed; music notes float around.

scene.id: Nenek di dapur menempelkan tangan di telinga; dari kamar terdengar Adik memanggil (gelombang suara).
scene.en: Grandma in the kitchen cups a hand to her ear; Little Sister is calling from her room (sound waves).

scene.id: Kakak dan teman kuliahnya duduk bersebelahan di bangku kelas, berbagi satu buku pelajaran.
scene.en: Big Brother and his classmate sit side by side at a classroom desk, sharing one textbook.

scene.id: Kotak kardus kosong; seekor kucing duduk di luar kotak, di sebelahnya. Panah menunjuk kucing.
scene.en: An empty cardboard box; a cat sits outside it, right next to it. An arrow points at the cat.

scene.id: Kakak bermain bola di luar rumah, sementara Nenek memperhatikan dari dalam lewat jendela.
scene.en: Big Brother plays ball outside the house while Grandma watches from inside through the window.

scene.id: Kakak mendorong Adik bermain ayunan di taman; keduanya tertawa.
scene.en: Big Brother pushes Little Sister on a swing in the park; both are laughing.

scene.id: Kakak berlari terengah-engah masuk kelas; jam dinding sudah lewat waktunya dan guru menunggu sambil bersedekap.
scene.en: Big Brother rushes into class out of breath; the wall clock is past the hour and the teacher waits with folded arms.

scene.id: Meja makan malam penuh hidangan hangat: ikan, sayur, dan nasi; lampu menyala dan bulan terlihat di jendela.
scene.en: A dinner table full of warm dishes: fish, vegetables and rice; the lamp is on and the moon shows in the window.

scene.id: Langit gelap berbintang dengan bulan; lampu jendela apartemen menyala; Adik sudah berpiyama.
scene.en: A dark starry sky with the moon; apartment windows are lit; Little Sister is already in pyjamas.

scene.id: Ayah menempelkan ponsel ke telinga dan menjawab panggilan; balon kecil berisi ikon telepon berdering.
scene.en: Dad holds his phone to his ear and answers a call; a small bubble shows a ringing-phone icon.

scene.id: Adik mengangkat tangan di kelas dan bertanya kepada guru; balon berisi tanda tanya.
scene.en: Little Sister raises her hand in class and asks the teacher a question; her bubble holds a question mark.

scene.id: Adik mengangkat tangan di kelas dengan tanda tanya di atas kepalanya; Guru menoleh dan tersenyum kepadanya.
scene.en: Little Sister raises her hand in class with a question mark above her head; the teacher turns and smiles at her.

scene.id: Adik menunjuk dadanya sendiri dengan bangga sambil bicara (balon kosong).
scene.en: Little Sister proudly points at her own chest while talking (empty speech bubble).

scene.id: Adik merangkul Kakak dan Ibu, lalu membuat lingkaran dengan tangannya yang mencakup mereka bertiga.
scene.en: Little Sister hugs Big Brother and Mom, then draws a circle with her hand that takes in all three of them.

scene.id: Adik membuka satu tangan dengan lima jari terentang; di sebelahnya lima bintang dan angka 5.
scene.en: Little Sister holds up one hand with five fingers spread; next to it are five stars and the digit 5.

scene.id: Nampan makan siang di kantin: semangkuk mi dan dua bakpao; jam dinding menunjuk pukul 12.
scene.en: A lunch tray in a canteen: a bowl of noodles and two steamed buns; the wall clock shows 12 o'clock.

scene.id: Seekor kucing tidur di bawah meja; Adik membungkuk mengintipnya. Panah ke bawah menunjuk kucing.
scene.en: A cat sleeps under the table; Little Sister bends down to peek at it. A down arrow points at the cat.

scene.id: Hujan turun deras; Ibu dan Adik berjalan berdua di bawah satu payung.
scene.en: It is pouring with rain; Mom and Little Sister walk together under one umbrella.

scene.id: Sore hari, Ayah keluar dari gedung kantor dan meregangkan tangan dengan lega; matahari terbenam.
scene.en: In the evening, Dad walks out of the office building and stretches his arms with relief; the sun is setting.

scene.id: Bel berbunyi; murid-murid berhamburan keluar kelas dengan gembira.
scene.en: The bell rings; the students pour happily out of the classroom.

scene.id: Adik menatap kios bubble tea; balon pikirannya berisi segelas bubble tea.
scene.en: Little Sister stares at a bubble tea stand; her thought bubble holds a cup of bubble tea.

scene.id: Pelayan membungkuk sopan menyambut Ayah yang berjas di pintu restoran.
scene.en: The waiter bows politely to welcome Dad, in a suit jacket, at the restaurant door.

scene.id: Adik menunjuk jam dinding besar dengan tegas; di bawahnya ada garis waktu dengan panah yang berhenti di titik tengah.
scene.en: Little Sister points firmly at a big wall clock; below it, a timeline arrow stops right at the middle point.

scene.id: Semangka besar di samping jeruk kecil; Adik memegang jeruk yang kecil itu.
scene.en: A big watermelon next to a small orange; Little Sister holds the small orange.

scene.id: Guru membungkuk ramah menyapa Adik yang kecil dan menepuk kepalanya.
scene.en: The teacher bends down kindly to greet little Little Sister and pats her on the head.

scene.id: Jam dinding dengan jarum panjang yang berputar satu putaran penuh, sementara jarum pendek bergeser dari angka 3 ke angka 4.
scene.en: A wall clock whose long hand goes all the way round once while the short hand moves from 3 to 4.

scene.id: Sekolah dasar yang dicat cerah dengan lapangan bermain; Adik masuk lewat gerbangnya.
scene.en: A brightly painted primary school with a playground; Little Sister walks in through its gate.

scene.id: Adik berseragam sekolah dasar dengan tas sekolah yang hampir sebesar badannya, melambai.
scene.en: Little Sister in her primary school uniform with a schoolbag almost as big as she is, waving.

scene.id: Matahari sudah condong ke barat dan jam menunjuk pukul 3; Kakak main bola sepulang sekolah.
scene.en: The sun has dipped toward the west and the clock shows 3; Big Brother plays football after school.

scene.id: Adik menulis di buku tulis dengan pensil, ujung lidahnya keluar karena serius; tulisannya hanya berupa garis-garis.
scene.en: Little Sister writes in her notebook with a pencil, tongue poking out in concentration; the writing is shown only as lines.

scene.id: Ibu mengambil beberapa (sekitar empat) jeruk dari tumpukan besar ke mangkuk buah.
scene.en: Mom takes a few (about four) oranges from a big pile into a fruit bowl.

scene.id: Ayah memberi Adik sebuah balon. Adik menerimanya, sedikit membungkuk, dan tersenyum (balon kata berisi hati).
scene.en: Dad gives Little Sister a balloon. She takes it, bows slightly and smiles (speech bubble with a heart).

scene.id: Adik memeluk boneka panda dengan mata berbentuk hati.
scene.en: Little Sister hugs a stuffed panda, her eyes turned into hearts.

scene.id: Adik memegang sepasang sepatu baru yang berkilau; di sebelahnya sepatu lama yang usang dan berlubang.
scene.en: Little Sister holds up a pair of shiny new shoes; next to them is an old, worn-out pair with holes.

scene.id: Kalender satu minggu: tujuh kotak berjajar. Lima kotak bergambar tas sekolah, dua kotak terakhir bergambar bola.
scene.en: A one-week calendar: seven boxes in a row. Five have a schoolbag drawn in them, the last two have a ball.

scene.id: Kotak terakhir di kalender mingguan bersinar; di sebelahnya keluarga Xiǎo berpiknik di taman.
scene.en: The last box of a weekly calendar glows; next to it the Xiǎo family has a picnic in the park.

scene.id: Minggu pagi, Ayah masih tidur-tiduran di sofa, sementara Adik menarik tangannya mengajak ke taman; kotak terakhir kalender mingguan bersinar.
scene.en: Sunday morning: Dad is still lazing on the sofa while Little Sister tugs his hand to go to the park; the last box of the weekly calendar glows.

scene.id: Kakek bersantai di kursi malas di balkon dengan secangkir teh, matanya terpejam.
scene.en: Grandpa relaxes in an armchair on the balcony with a cup of tea, eyes closed.

scene.id: Adik belajar naik sepeda di taman; Ibu memegangi sadelnya dari belakang.
scene.en: Little Sister is learning to ride a bike in the park; Mom holds the saddle from behind.

scene.id: Salju turun di halaman; Kakak dan Adik membuat manusia salju bertopi dan bersyal.
scene.en: Snow falls in the yard; Big Brother and Little Sister build a snowman with a hat and a scarf.

scene.id: Para murid berseragam, termasuk Kakak dan Adik, berbaris masuk ke sekolah.
scene.en: Students in uniform, Big Brother and Little Sister among them, line up to walk into school.

scene.id: Malam hari, Kakak belajar di mejanya dengan buku, buku catatan, dan lampu meja.
scene.en: In the evening, Big Brother studies at his desk with books, a notebook and a desk lamp.

scene.id: Gedung sekolah dengan gerbang, lapangan, dan jam besar di dinding; Kakak dan Adik berjalan masuk.
scene.en: A school building with a gate, a playground and a big clock on the wall; Big Brother and Little Sister walk in.

scene.id: Di toko mainan, Adik menunjuk mobil-mobilan dengan tegas sambil menarik lengan Ayah.
scene.en: In a toy shop, Little Sister points firmly at a toy car while tugging Dad's sleeve.

scene.id: Kakak mengangkat tangan minta bubble tea. Adik di sebelahnya ikut mengangkat tangan dengan pose yang persis sama.
scene.en: Big Brother raises his hand to ask for bubble tea. Little Sister next to him raises her hand in exactly the same pose.

scene.id: Satu apel merah di atas meja, dengan angka 1 di atasnya.
scene.en: One red apple on a table, with the digit 1 above it.

scene.id: Kakak membelah satu bakpao menjadi dua dan memberikan separuhnya kepada Adik.
scene.en: Big Brother breaks a steamed bun in two and gives half to Little Sister.

scene.id: Ayah menuang teh sedikit saja ke cangkir Adik, cuma membasahi dasarnya. Adik mencubitkan dua jari: "sedikit".
scene.en: Dad pours just a little tea into Little Sister's cup, barely covering the bottom. She pinches two fingers together: "a little".

scene.id: Lemari terbuka berisi baju yang tergantung rapi: kaos, kemeja, rok, dan celana.
scene.en: An open wardrobe with clothes hanging neatly: T-shirts, shirts, a skirt and trousers.

scene.id: Dokter berjas putih dengan stetoskop di leher tersenyum sambil memegang papan catatan.
scene.en: The doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope round his neck smiles, holding a clipboard.

scene.id: Ibu menyodorkan sesendok sup dari panci. Adik mencicipinya sekilas dengan ujung lidah.
scene.en: Mom holds out a spoonful of soup from the pot. Little Sister takes a quick taste with the tip of her tongue.

scene.id: Di piring besar ada banyak pangsit; Kakak mengambil beberapa (empat atau lima) dengan sumpit ke mangkuknya.
scene.en: A big plate holds lots of dumplings; Big Brother uses chopsticks to move a few (four or five) into his bowl.

scene.id: Gedung rumah sakit dengan ikon tanda plus putih di kotak biru; ambulans parkir di depan dan dokter berdiri di pintu.
scene.en: A hospital building with a white plus sign on a blue square; an ambulance is parked in front and the doctor stands at the door.

scene.id: Kursi kayu di sisi meja makan; Kakek duduk di atasnya sambil membaca koran.
scene.en: A wooden chair beside the dining table; Grandpa sits on it reading a newspaper.

scene.id: Adik memamerkan boneka beruang di tangannya dengan bangga; Kakak di sebelahnya menunjukkan kedua tangan yang kosong.
scene.en: Little Sister proudly shows off the teddy bear in her hands; Big Brother next to her shows two empty hands.

scene.id: Guru bertanya ke kelas. Kakak mengangkat tangan, sedangkan teman kuliahnya tetap menunduk.
scene.en: The teacher asks the class a question. Big Brother raises his hand, while his classmate keeps his head down.

scene.id: Satu tandan pisang: beberapa buah sudah kuning, beberapa masih hijau.
scene.en: A bunch of bananas: some are already yellow, some are still green.

scene.id: Adik menyentuh cangkir teh dan mengibaskan tangan: sedikit terlalu panas (jari telunjuk dan ibu jari hampir bertemu); balon kata berisi uap.
scene.en: Little Sister touches a cup of tea and shakes her hand: a bit too hot (her thumb and finger almost touching); speech bubble with steam.

scene.id: Rintik hujan turun dari awan kelabu; genangan air di jalan beriak.
scene.en: Raindrops fall from grey clouds; puddles ripple in the street.

scene.id: Sebuah bakpao dengan label harga berangka 2; di sebelahnya dua keping koin satu yuan.
scene.en: A steamed bun with a price tag showing the digit 2; next to it are two one-yuan coins.

scene.id: Bulan sabit di langit malam di atas gedung apartemen; di jendela tergantung kalender satu bulan.
scene.en: A crescent moon in the night sky above an apartment block; a one-month calendar hangs in a window.

scene.id: Adik menghabiskan mangkuknya lalu menyodorkan mangkuk kosong itu ke Nenek, minta tambah; panah melingkar di atasnya.
scene.en: Little Sister finishes her bowl and holds the empty bowl out to Grandma for more; a circular arrow is above it.

scene.id: Adik bersembunyi di dalam lemari, hanya kepalanya yang mengintip dari celah pintu; panah menunjuk tempatnya.
scene.en: Little Sister hides inside the wardrobe with only her head peeking out of the gap in the door; an arrow points to where she is.

scene.id: Di depan pintu apartemen, Adik dengan tas sekolah di punggung melambai ke Nenek. Nenek membalas lambaiannya dari ambang pintu.
scene.en: At the apartment door, Little Sister with her schoolbag on her back waves to Grandma. Grandma waves back from the doorway.

scene.id: Adik tiba pertama di gerbang sekolah yang masih sepi; matahari baru terbit dan jam menunjuk pukul 7.
scene.en: Little Sister is the first to arrive at the still-empty school gate; the sun has just risen and the clock shows 7.

scene.id: Meja sarapan pagi: susu kedelai, cakwe, dan bakpao; matahari terbit terlihat dari jendela.
scene.en: A breakfast table: soy milk, fried dough sticks and steamed buns; the rising sun shows through the window.

scene.id: Pagi-pagi, matahari baru terbit; Kakek dan Nenek berlatih tai chi di taman.
scene.en: Early morning, the sun has just come up; Grandpa and Grandma practise tai chi in the park.

scene.id: Kakek memegang ponsel baru dan menatap layarnya dengan bingung (balon berisi tanda tanya dan roda gigi).
scene.en: Grandpa holds a new phone and stares at the screen, puzzled (bubble with a question mark and a gear).

scene.id: Ibu memamerkan baju barunya dan bertanya kepada Ayah (balon kata berisi tanda tanya, jempol naik, dan jempol turun).
scene.en: Mom shows off her new outfit and asks Dad (speech bubble with a question mark, a thumbs-up and a thumbs-down).

scene.id: Ayah mencari kacamata Kakek di bawah sofa dengan senter, padahal kacamata itu ada di atas kepala Kakek.
scene.en: Dad searches under the sofa with a torch for Grandpa's glasses, while the glasses are sitting on Grandpa's head.

scene.id: Adik memegang apel di tangannya, dekat dengan dirinya, dan menunjuknya. Apel lain tergeletak jauh di meja seberang.
scene.en: Little Sister holds an apple close to herself and points at it. Another apple lies far away on a table across the room.

scene.id: Di restoran, pelayan mengarahkan Ibu ke meja di sisi dekatnya dengan telapak tangan terbuka.
scene.en: In a restaurant, the waiter shows Mom to a table on his near side with an open palm.

scene.id: Adik memegang boneka beruang dan menyodorkannya ke depan; di rak belakangnya masih ada boneka lain.
scene.en: Little Sister holds a teddy bear and holds it out in front of her; more toys sit on the shelf behind her.

scene.id: Ayah memegang peta taman dan menunjuk ke tanah tepat di bawah kakinya; di peta ada pin lokasi merah.
scene.en: Dad holds a park map and points at the ground right under his feet; a red location pin marks the map.

scene.id: Adik memegang dua bunga, satu plastik dan satu asli; ia mencium yang asli dan tersenyum.
scene.en: Little Sister holds two flowers, one plastic and one real; she smells the real one and smiles.

scene.id: Ibu sedang menumis sayur di wajan yang mengepul; panah melingkar berputar di atasnya.
scene.en: Mom is in the middle of stir-frying vegetables in a steaming wok; a circular arrow spins above her.

scene.id: Ibu menepuk tempat kosong di sofa tepat di sebelahnya, memanggil Adik untuk duduk di situ.
scene.en: Mom pats the empty spot on the sofa right beside her, calling Little Sister to sit there.

scene.id: Adik memeluk beberapa boneka di dadanya dan menunjuknya. Di rak yang jauh ada boneka-boneka lain.
scene.en: Little Sister hugs several stuffed toys to her chest and points at them. Other toys sit on a shelf far away.

scene.id: Tiga burung kecil bertengger berjajar di satu dahan; angka 3 di atasnya.
scene.en: Three small birds perch in a row on one branch; the digit 3 above them.

scene.id: Ibu bertanya di mana kunci (balon tanda tanya); Kakak dengan yakin menunjuk gantungan kunci di dinding.
scene.en: Mom asks where the keys are (question-mark bubble); Big Brother confidently points at the key hook on the wall.

scene.id: Peta Tiongkok dengan bintang kecil di posisi Beijing, dihiasi ikon panda dan Tembok Besar.
scene.en: A map of China with a small star at Beijing's location, decorated with a panda and the Great Wall.

scene.id: Kakak membuka buku pelajaran bahasa Mandarin yang sampulnya bergambar peta Tiongkok.
scene.en: Big Brother opens a Chinese-language textbook with a map of China on the cover.

scene.id: Matahari tepat di atas kepala dan jam menunjuk pukul 12; Ayah membuka kotak bekalnya.
scene.en: The sun is right overhead and the clock shows 12; Dad opens his lunch box.

scene.id: Gedung sekolah menengah bertingkat dengan lapangan basket; Kakak berjalan ke kelas.
scene.en: A multi-storey secondary school building with a basketball court; Big Brother walks to class.

scene.id: Kakak memakai seragam olahraga sekolah (jaket biru-putih), membawa tas dan buku tebal.
scene.en: Big Brother in his school tracksuit uniform (blue and white jacket), carrying a bag and a thick book.

scene.id: Malam hari, di satu jendela gedung apartemen tampak keluarga Xiǎo makan malam; panah besar menunjuk jendela itu.
scene.en: At night, the Xiǎo family can be seen eating dinner in one window of an apartment block; a big arrow points at that window.

scene.id: Meja kayu bundar di ruang makan dengan empat kursi di sekelilingnya.
scene.en: A round wooden dining table with four chairs around it.

scene.id: Di papan tulis ada satu kotak petak besar yang kosong; guru memegang kapur, siap menulis satu huruf.
scene.en: On the blackboard is one big empty grid square; the teacher holds chalk, ready to write a single character.

scene.id: Kakak duduk di kursi kereta dan memandang ke luar jendela.
scene.en: Big Brother sits in a train seat looking out of the window.

scene.id: Nenek dan Adik membuat pangsit bersama: menggiling kulit, mengisi, dan melipatnya.
scene.en: Grandma and Little Sister make dumplings together: rolling the wrappers, filling them and folding them.

scene.id: Ibu memasak di dapur: mengaduk wajan berisi sayur yang mengepul, sementara Adik membantu mencuci tomat.
scene.en: Mom cooks in the kitchen: she stirs a steaming wok of vegetables while Little Sister helps wash tomatoes.

scene.id: Kalender: panah mundur dari kotak hari ini ke kotak sebelumnya. Balon pikiran Kakak berisi pertandingan bola kemarin.
scene.en: A calendar: an arrow goes back from today's box to the one before. Big Brother's thought bubble shows yesterday's football match.
